data.title: 音色创造 (深海狂鲨)
data.instruction:
Voice Description

A sweet young girl whale with a soft, gentle, and slightly breathy voice. Light and youthful, with a warm, rounded tone and a subtle airy quality. She speaks softly and somewhat hesitantly, often sounding shy and easily embarrassed. Her voice has a delicate, innocent charm, with small changes in pitch when she becomes excited or surprised. Overall, she sounds adorable, timid, kind-hearted, and naturally endearing without being overly childish or exaggerated.
data.naturalControl:
Character

A shy little whale girl who is gentle, kind, and easily embarrassed. She tends to avoid attention and becomes flustered when people talk to her directly. Although timid at first, she is curious about the world and becomes cheerful and expressive once she feels comfortable around others.

Scene

Meeting new people, quietly greeting strangers, answering questions with slight hesitation, reacting shyly to compliments, and becoming excited when talking about things she likes. When surprised or embarrassed, she may stumble over her words or let out a tiny nervous giggle.

Direction

Keep the voice soft, youthful, and feminine with a gentle, airy quality. Speak slightly softly with hesitant pauses and a naturally shy delivery. Use subtle pitch changes to express embarrassment and excitement. Avoid sounding overly childish, squeaky, or artificially cute. The overall performance should feel innocent, timid, warm, and genuinely adorable.
